sessionTitle: Ship safer code from your IDE with Aikido

announcements.name: Aikido plugin for VS Code
announcements.shortDescription: An IDE extension that scans files for secrets, code security issues, infrastructure-as-code issues, and code quality issues during development.
announcements.longDescription: The Aikido plugin for VS Code is an IDE extension that scans your files for secrets, code security issues, infrastructure-as-code (IEC) issues, and code quality issues while you're developing, embodying a shift-left approach. It is easy to install, requiring an Aikido license and login via a login button or a personal access token. Once files are open, it identifies issues and pinpoints exactly where they occur, allowing you to assess impact with Aikido AI, report false positives, or fix them with Aikido AI.

announcements.name: Pre-commit hook
announcements.shortDescription: Checks for any secrets before a commit is made.
announcements.longDescription: The Aikido plugin includes a pre-commit hook as one of its extra features. It checks whether there are any secrets present before you commit your code.

announcements.name: Safe Chain malware package scanner
announcements.shortDescription: Bundled malware scanner for packages, included with the plugin.
announcements.longDescription: Safe Chain is a malware package scanner included with the Aikido plugin. It is bundled alongside other features such as the pre-commit hook and the Aikido MCP.

announcements.name: Aikido MCP
announcements.shortDescription: Runs on generated code and executed prompts to support workflows such as vibe coding.
announcements.longDescription: The Aikido MCP is a component of the plugin that helps with workflows such as vibe coding. On every piece of code that gets created or every prompt that is run, the Aikido MCP is also run.

announcements.name: Fix with Aikido AI
announcements.shortDescription: AI-generated fixes that can be pushed directly into a file or rejected, with red lines marking problematic code and green lines marking the suggested replacement.
announcements.longDescription: Fix with Aikido AI provides AI-generated fixes for detected issues. When you click the fix button on the right-hand side, a new tab pops up offering a fix if one is available, which can be pushed straight into the file or rejected if you don't like the solution. In the diff view, red lines mark the bad lines and green lines mark the suggested good replacement.

announcements.name: Workspace and dependency scans
announcements.shortDescription: A full workspace scan lists all files with detected issues, and a dependency scan surfaces vulnerable open-source dependencies with autofix capability in the IDE.
announcements.longDescription: While other scans are running, you can also run a dependency scan and a full-on workspace scan across an entire repo loaded in VS Code. A workspace scan runs through the entire workspace and lists all of the files where an issue was detected, letting you click through each one. A dependency scan surfaces open-source dependencies and their issues, with the ability to fix them using Aikido AI or report false positives.
